discriminating_test.inputs: Row ac-00975, start [[-2,-2,-1,2,-1,-2,1,2,1,1,-2,-1,2,-1],[-2,-2,-1,2,-1,-2,1,2,-1,-1,-2,-2,1,-2,-1,2,-1]], harvested AC35 route from ledger seq 648 (research/acc/live/charlie/charlie_surgery_bundle_20260929.json:[3].moves; identical to charlie_surgery.jsonl:4 route). Tool: Charlie's surgery.py (research/acc/live/charlie/v45/tools/surgery.py) with acc_disk (tools/acc/charlie/acc_disk.cpp), cap forced to 37 instead of peak+2, MAXST 80000000 per search, W 11, MEM 2500. Three parallel lanes: HEAD (radius-9 ball around s_0 under cap 37, then acc_disk from s_L for L = 10..22 to depth L-10 meeting the ball), TAIL (from s_{35-L}, L = 10..22, meeting B36), WINDOWS (all stretches <=11 under cap 37). Fourth core replays any shortened route through the pinned official AC verifier (SAIR a0fd6e6f52d82c93ccc06ab91d81e8fa3678256e, per CODEX note). Optional rider at no extra ball cost: the Stable (y,x) route of sac-00975 (charlie_surgery.jsonl:5) through the same head ball.
discriminating_test.limits: Wall 2400 s total on 4 cores; MAXST 80000000 states per acc_disk search; cap 37; W 11; head/tail L <= 22. Cap-33 reference: 579.3 s single process, head/tail 22, windows 11 (charlie_surgery.jsonl:4). A budget stop is a scoped miss, not an impossibility claim; nothing here proves the 35 route optimal.
discriminating_test.observe: Per lane and per L: 'shortened' (with the new verified route and its peak length), 'certified' (search closed under cap 37 with no meet), or 'budget stop' (MAXST hit; inconclusive at that L). Record the largest certified L for head and tail, the windows verdict, wall time and state counts. Any shortened route is a new_path event for the row (ledger reopen_when, seq 2532).

outcomes.a head, tail or window shortens at cap 3: the record climbs above start+2; the length key and the cap-33 certificates were the bottleneck. Keep the ceiling: rerun surgery at cap 39 on the new route, add it to the pool, and run window/tail on it; do not return to the beam family on this row.
outcomes.budget stop before L = 22 in head or tai: scope-limited: report certified L only. Next action is the same seed switch as above, plus a second surgery pass at cap 35 to close the gap between 33 and 37 where the state count allows; no cap-37 claim beyond the certified L.
outcomes.head 22, tail 22 and windows 11 all cert: the 34-route shares no state with ours in 13..22 even with a +6 climb: it is non-local, not a climbing variant. Next switch is seed: off-corridor start-ball seeds (exact ball radius 5-6 around s_0, stratified by total length including 32-36, excluding states within 2 moves of any of our routes) fed to beam_p2 with DMAX = 34 - r; acc_beam already accepts any start pair (acc_beam.c:6, run_beam_raw.py enc()).

If false, every exact certificate on this row (all at cap 33 or local) and every length-keyed beam are blind in the same place, and further seed/pool/window changes inside that ceiling cannot change what scores. Supporting but not justifying [H]: the team's pool profile puts record/start = 34/31 = 1.10 in the buckets where 28/39 and 54/73 record routes climb above the start (median +2, max far higher) (IDEAS.md, 2026-09-28 15:00Z Smith-chart section), while our routes on this row never rise above the start (IDEAS.md:1648).

result.summary: Every exact negative on ac-00975 is either local (uncapped acc_window over pairs <=14 apart on our own route, plus depth-3 crossovers among our three AC35 routes) or capped at total length 33: Charlie's surgery certified windows<=11, head 22 and tail 22 with cap = peak+2 = 33 (/home/user/operator-first/research/acc/live/charlie/v45/charlie_surgery.jsonl:4; cap rule at /home/user/operator-first/research/acc/live/charlie/v45/tools/surgery.py:111). Every heuristic family (beam from start at W 20000/100000/200000, on-path restarts, climb-at-opening) uses a length key whose routes never rise above the start length 31 (IDEAS.md:1648). Together these say: a 34-route either shares no state with ours in positions 13..22 and diverges over a span >=15, or it climbs above 33 inside a head/tail segment, a region no run on this row has ever examined. The C16 note already recommended 'a different bridge, rank/heuristic, or higher ceiling' (CODEX_C16_REVERSE_20260928.md:33). I propose switching method and capture: exact surgery (start-side radius-9 head ball + B36 tail meet + windows 11) on the harvested AC35 route at ceiling 37 (start+6) with a per-search state budget, run as three parallel lanes. It is deterministic, bounded, finishes well under 40 minutes on 4 cores (the cap-33 pass took 579 s in one process, charlie_surgery.jsonl:4), and its outcomes point to different next actions. More beam width, seeds, window14, tail-replace with a bigger slack (cap = peak+slack is a knob, tail_replace.py:21), or yx (SAC-only, seq 2582) would all stay inside the ceiling-33 / local blind spot.
